info.title: Platform 5E API
info.description:
Backend of **Platform 5E**: teachers upload the material of a unit, generate 5E learning resources that cite it
(RAG), review them and export the approved ones to Moodle (Moodle XML) or Chamilo (SCORM 1.2).

**Authentication.** `POST /api/v1/accounts` or `POST /api/v1/sessions` return a bearer token. Click *Authorize* and
paste only the token. Private routes answer 401 without it.

**Errors.** Every error has the same shape: `{"error": {"code": "UNIT_NOT_FOUND", "message": "…"}}`. The `code` is
stable and in English; the `message` is shown to the teacher, so it is in Spanish.

**Stored values.** Review statuses (`pendiente`, `aprobado`, `descartado`), resource types (`item_opcion_multiple`…)
and difficulties (`basica`, `intermedia`, `avanzada`) are values saved in the database. They move to English in
Sprint 2 together with a data migration.

get.summary: List supported resource types in teaching order
get.description:
Public metadata only: no teacher data, session or external AI calls.

Example (Bash/cURL). Set BASE_URL to the API URL and TOKEN to a valid bearer token.
Use your own ids for path variables and replace sample ids such as unidad-1 in JSON bodies.

```bash
curl --fail-with-body -i -X GET "$BASE_URL/api/v1/resource-types"
```

Expected 200. See the response schema below for the returned fields.

post.description:
Creates the course with at least one unit. The code is stored in uppercase and must be unique (409).

Duplicate unit titles return 409 `DUPLICATE_UNIT_TITLE`. Duplicate learning outcome codes or texts return 409 `DUPLICATE_OUTCOME`. The first conflict's `error.details` includes `field` (`title`, `code`, or `text`), zero-based `unitIndex`, and `outcomeIndex` for learning outcomes.

Use your own ids for path variables and replace sample ids such as unidad-1 in JSON bodies.

```bash
curl --fail-with-body -i -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/v1/courses" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"code":"RED-301","name":"Redes de computadoras","term":"2026-II","units":[{"title":"Capa de transporte","outcomes":[{"code":"RA1","text":"Distingue los protocolos TCP y UDP."}]}]}'
```

Expected 201. Use a different code if RED-301 already exists for this teacher.

Replaces the course data. Existing units must be sent back with their id; new units have none.

Duplicate unit titles return 409 `DUPLICATE_UNIT_TITLE`. Duplicate learning outcome codes or texts return 409 `DUPLICATE_OUTCOME`. The first conflict's `error.details` includes `field` (`title`, `code`, or `text`), zero-based `unitIndex`, and `outcomeIndex` for learning outcomes.


Replace unidad-1 with an existing unit id. Copy existing unit and outcome ids from GET /courses before editing to preserve them. Expected 200.

post.description:
Interprets a teacher's message for a unit they own and returns an editable draft.
The endpoint uses deterministic rules and creates no generation request.

Example (Bash/cURL). Set BASE_URL to the API URL and TOKEN to a valid bearer token.
Replace unidad-1 with the ID of a unit you own.

```bash
curl -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/v1/generation-requests/interpret" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data '{"unitId":"unidad-1","message":"Quiero dos glosarios"}'
```

Expected 200 with the draft, derived 5E stages, and interpretation issues.

post.description:
Validates the unit ownership, the outcome and that the unit has processed material, saves the request
and runs it in the background (202 with `Location`). Poll `GET /generation-requests/{requestId}` for the
status of each step.

GEN-P2: the body is `{planId, planVersion}` of an approved plan. The mode, unit, types, quantities and
evidence come from the plan, which becomes `used` together with the request: one step per plan item, each
resource drafted from its block of concepts. A draft plan answers 422 PLAN_NOT_APPROVED; another version
409 PLAN_VERSION_CONFLICT; a used plan 409 PLAN_ALREADY_USED. If a fragment cited by the plan no longer
exists in the unit (a document was deleted or reprocessed), the answer is 409 PLAN_EVIDENCE_STALE with one
`StaleDocument` per document in `details`, and nothing changes. While `GENERATION_REQUIRE_PLAN=false` the
previous body below is still accepted: the server builds an implicit approved plan (422 PLAN_INVALID with
the problems in `details` if it cannot be approved, 422 INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE if the material does not cover
the topic); with `true` it answers 422 PLAN_REQUIRED.

The client sends a stable `Idempotency-Key`, unique per teacher. Repeating the same key with the same body
(mode, unit and parameters) returns the existing request (200) without applying the other rules again;
using it with a different body returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. Without processed material the request
is rejected (400 NO_PROCESSED_MATERIAL), and a teacher with 2 active requests gets 429 with `Retry-After`.

Example (Bash/cURL). Set BASE_URL to the API URL and TOKEN to a valid bearer token.
Use your own ids for path variables and replace sample ids such as unidad-1 in JSON bodies.

```bash
curl --fail-with-body -i -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/v1/generation-requests" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"mode":"sequence","unitId":"unidad-1","resourceTypes":["pregunta_detonante","item_opcion_multiple"],"quantity":1}'
```

Replace unidad-1 with a unit containing processed material. Expected 202; repeat with the same key to get 200.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

schema.description: Stable client key, unique per teacher: 8 to 128 letters, digits, `-` or `_`. Reuse it when retrying the same request. Without it the API answers 400 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED; with another format, 422 INVALID_PARAMETERS.

resources, rejections with their reason, generator and fallback flags. Requests of other teachers answer
404 GENERATION_REQUEST_NOT_FOUND, the same as missing ones.


Expected 200. Poll until `status` is `succeeded`, `partially_succeeded`, `failed` or `interrupted`.

get.summary: Get the active generator
get.description:
Says whether resources are drafted by a language model (and which one) or by the rule-based generator.

Example (Bash/cURL). Set BASE_URL to the API URL and TOKEN to a valid bearer token.
Use your own ids for path variables and replace sample ids such as unidad-1 in JSON bodies.

```bash
curl --fail-with-body -i -X GET "$BASE_URL/api/v1/generator"
```

Expected 200. See the response schema below for the returned fields.

post.description:
Retrieves the unit evidence once and freezes it in the plan, adds the referents and the previous
typologies, drafts the plan with one AI call (within the per-call deadline) or with the rule-based planner,
and validates it. If the AI fails, times out or returns an invalid plan, the rule-based planner drafts it and
`generator.fallbackReason` says why. The plan is saved in `draft` even with problems; see `validation`.

Same `Idempotency-Key` with the same body returns the existing plan (200); with another body, 409.

Example (Bash/cURL). Set BASE_URL to the API URL and TOKEN to a valid bearer token.
Use your own ids for path variables and replace sample ids such as unidad-1 in JSON bodies.

```bash
curl --fail-with-body -i -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/v1/generation-plans" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"unitId":"unidad-1","instructions":"Diferencias entre TCP y UDP","resourceTypes":[{"type":"pregunta_detonante","quantity":1},{"type":"explicacion"}]}'
```

Replace unidad-1 with a unit containing processed material. Expected 201; repeat with the same key to get
200.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

schema.description: Stable client key, unique per teacher: 8 to 128 letters, digits, `-` or `_`, as in GEN-01. Reuse it when retrying the same plan. Without it the API answers 400 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED.
schema.title: Idempotency-Key

parameters.description: Stable client key, unique per teacher: 8 to 128 letters, digits, `-` or `_`, as in GEN-01. Reuse it when retrying the same plan. Without it the API answers 400 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED.

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired session token.

404.description: `UNIT_NOT_FOUND`: missing or belongs to another teacher.

409.description: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`: the key was already used by this teacher with a different body.

422.description: `INVALID_PARAMETERS` (type, range, unknown or repeated type), `RESOURCE_TYPE_NOT_IN_MODALITY`, or `INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE`: the unit material does not cover the topic of the instructions; the message names what is missing. No plan is created.

429.description: Per-IP limit of costly routes, with `Retry-After`.

503.description: The database or an external source is not available.

200.description: The same key and body were already used; the existing plan is returned.

get.summary: List the teacher's plans of a unit
get.description:
Plans of the teacher in the unit, most recently updated first (empty list if none). Used to recover the
last plan after a reload. A unit of another teacher answers 404 UNIT_NOT_FOUND, the same as a missing one.

Example (Bash/cURL). Set BASE_URL to the API URL and TOKEN to a valid bearer token.
Use your own ids for path variables and replace sample ids such as unidad-1 in JSON bodies.

```bash
curl --fail-with-body -i -X GET "$BASE_URL/api/v1/generation-plans?unitId=unidad-1&status=draft" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```

Replace unidad-1 with one of your units. Expected 200.

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired session token.

422.description: Invalid parameters (type, range or unknown field).

404.description: `UNIT_NOT_FOUND`: missing or another teacher's.

get.summary: Get a plan
get.description:
Returns the plan, with `validation` and `doesNotCover` computed on read. Plans of other teachers answer
404 PLAN_NOT_FOUND, the same as missing ones.

Example (Bash/cURL). Set BASE_URL to the API URL and TOKEN to a valid bearer token.
Use your own ids for path variables and replace sample ids such as unidad-1 in JSON bodies.

```bash
curl --fail-with-body -i -X GET "$BASE_URL/api/v1/generation-plans/${PLAN_ID}" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```

Expected 200.

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired session token.

404.description: `PLAN_NOT_FOUND`: missing or belongs to another teacher. Both answers are identical.

422.description: Validation Error

put.description:
Replaces the items. The stage of each item comes from the catalog and `doesNotCover` is computed. The
plan goes back to `draft` and its `version` increases. An invalid plan is saved anyway, with its problems in
`validation`, so the teacher does not lose work; it cannot be approved until it is valid. `inputs` and
`evidence` do not change: to change the topic or the types, create a new plan. A type that is not in the
catalog answers 422 INVALID_PARAMETERS.

Example (Bash/cURL). Set BASE_URL to the API URL and TOKEN to a valid bearer token.
Use your own ids for path variables and replace sample ids such as unidad-1 in JSON bodies.

```bash
curl --fail-with-body -i -X PUT "$BASE_URL/api/v1/generation-plans/${PLAN_ID}" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"expectedVersion":1,"items":[{"resourceType":"explicacion","quantity":1,"purpose":"Explicar TCP","covers":["control de flujo"],"fragmentIds":["frag-1"]}]}'
```

Expected 200. Check `validation`.

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired session token.

422.description: Invalid parameters (type, range or unknown field).

404.description: `PLAN_NOT_FOUND`: missing or belongs to another teacher. Both answers are identical.

409.description: `PLAN_VERSION_CONFLICT`: `expectedVersion` is not the current version. `PLAN_ALREADY_USED`: the plan already started a generation request.

post.description:
REV-C12 and REV-C13 (decision D10, confirmed by Generation): asks Generation for a new resource with the
stored parameters and the current evidence of the material. If Generation does not finish within its time
limit, the answer is `status: running` and the request goes on in the background: ask
`GET …/resources/{resource_id}/regeneration` until it ends.

On success the new resources wait for review (they keep `regeneratedFrom` and are verified when read) and the
previous one goes to discarded with reason `regenerado`, but only if it is still at `expectedVersion`; if it
was edited meanwhile, both stay in review (`previousDiscarded: false`). Asking again from the same version
returns the same result without generating again. On failure the previous resource is unchanged and `message`
gives the reason: when Generation rejects the request for the teacher's data, its code is kept (409 for the
unit material, such as NO_PROCESSED_MATERIAL or PLAN_EVIDENCE_STALE: a fragment of the plan item no longer
exists in the unit (a document was deleted or reprocessed); details lists the affected documents
(documentId, documentName, missingFragmentIds). The resource is unchanged; create a new plan; 422 for the stored
parameters, such as INVALID_OUTCOME). If Generation finished but none of the new resources is still in review,
the answer is 409 REGENERATED_RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND and the regeneration can be asked again. Rejections when
Generation starts the request keep the status of `generation-requests`: 404 UNIT_NOT_FOUND, 429
TOO_MANY_ACTIVE_REQUESTS and 409 REGENERATION_ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED. 502 REGENERATION_FAILED is only for
provider or unexpected failures. An outdated `expectedVersion` returns 409 VERSION_CONFLICT.

Example (Bash/cURL). Set BASE_URL to the API URL and TOKEN to a valid bearer token.
Use your own ids for path variables and replace sample ids such as unidad-1 in JSON bodies.

```bash
curl --fail-with-body -i -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/v1/units/${UNIT_ID}/resources/${RESOURCE_ID}/regenerations" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"expectedVersion":1}'
```

Use a resource of your unit with its current version. Expected 200.

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired session token.

404.description: The entity does not exist or does not belong to the teacher.

409.description: VERSION_CONFLICT; Generation rejected the request for the unit material (NO_PROCESSED_MATERIAL, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE); PLAN_EVIDENCE_STALE: a fragment of the plan item no longer exists in the unit (a document was deleted or reprocessed); details lists the affected documents (documentId, documentName, missingFragmentIds). The resource is unchanged; create a new plan; REGENERATED_RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND, when Generation finished but no new resource is still in review; or REGENERATION_ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED, when the attempts from this version ran out (edit the resource to ask again). The previous resource is unchanged.

422.description: Invalid body, or Generation rejected the stored parameters (INVALID_OUTCOME, INVALID_SEQUENCE, REGENERATION_PARAMETERS_MISSING, REGENERATION_TARGET_INVALID). The previous resource is unchanged.

429.description: TOO_MANY_ACTIVE_REQUESTS: the teacher already has the maximum of active generation requests, as in generation-requests. The previous resource is unchanged; try again later.

502.description: REGENERATION_FAILED: only for provider or unexpected failures. The previous resource is unchanged.

post.summary: Export the approved resources of a unit
post.description:
Builds the file in the backend from the approved resources (fixed templates, never written by the AI),
records the download in the unit history and returns the file.

- `scorm_zip`: SCORM 1.2 package for Chamilo, one page per resource in 5E order; questions are graded.
- `moodle_xml`: Moodle question bank with multiple-choice, true/false and matching questions.
- `documento`: printable HTML document of the approved unit resources, with evidence.

Example (Bash/cURL). Set BASE_URL to the API URL and TOKEN to a valid bearer token.
Use your own ids for path variables and replace sample ids such as unidad-1 in JSON bodies.

```bash
curl --fail-with-body -X POST "$BASE_URL/api/v1/units/${UNIT_ID}/exports" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"format":"scorm_zip","resourceIds":[]}' -D respuesta-headers.txt --output unidad-scorm.zip
```

Expected 200 when the unit has eligible resources. An empty resourceIds selects every eligible resource compatible with scorm_zip.

REV-01: the three formats use the same filter. A resource is exported only if it is approved, has a current
verification for its present content and no invalidated media, and the format supports it. Resources without a
stored verification are checked first. If none is eligible, the answer is 422 NO_APPROVED_RESOURCES and no
file is made; `details` gives how many resources were left out for each reason, for example
`[{"reason": "verification_pending", "count": 2}]`. Reasons: `not_approved`, `verification_missing`,
`verification_outdated`, `verification_insufficient`, `verification_pending`, `media_invalidated`,
`unsupported_format`. Each export records one download with the course and the unit.

planId.description: GEN-P2: the approved plan the request started from (an implicit one for the previous body). `null` in requests created before generation plans.

planVersion.title: Planversion
planVersion.description: GEN-P2: the plan version that was used.

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: One step per resource type, in 5E order. With a plan, one step per plan item, in plan order.

GenerationRequestStatus.title: GenerationRequestStatus
GenerationRequestStatus.description: Estado del pedido y de cada paso, en orden 5E, tal como lo confirmó el servidor.

request.title: Request
request.description: The saved request, with its id.

resources.title: Resources
resources.description: Generated resources, saved as `pendiente` for review.

distractorReliability.description: Only with the teacher's material (`rag`): distractor reliability check (HU-019).

grounding.description: Only with the teacher's material (`rag`): grounding check of the request (HU-016).

sequence.title: Sequence
sequence.description: Only in sequence requests (`resourceTypes`): one step per stage agent.

retrievedChunks.title: Retrievedchunks
retrievedChunks.description: Everything retrieved, not only what was cited. Used by the Ragas evaluation.

resourceIds.title: Resourceids
resourceIds.description: Resources delivered to Review in this step. Read them with `GET /units/{unitId}/resources/{id}`.

resources.title: Resources
resources.description: Short view of the delivered resources.

planItemPosition.title: Planitemposition
planItemPosition.description: GEN-P2: the plan item this step drafts. `null` in requests without a plan.

planWarnings.title: Planwarnings
planWarnings.description: GEN-P2: AI resources of this step delivered although they did not fully follow the plan (another item's concept developed, or none of their own). The rule-based path rejects them with `kind: plan` instead.

usesAi.title: Usesai
usesAi.description: False when the rule-based generator is active.

checkedClaims.title: Checkedclaims
checkedClaims.description: Claims checked, in kept and rejected resources.

hallucinationRate.title: Hallucinationrate
hallucinationRate.description: I21: unsupported / checked claims (null when nothing was checked).

unsupportedParagraphs.title: Unsupportedparagraphs
unsupportedParagraphs.description: Explanation paragraphs and glossary entries removed for lack of support (HU-049).

rejectedResources.title: Rejectedresources
rejectedResources.description: Resources rejected because less than half of their claims had support.

GroundingReport.title: GroundingReport
GroundingReport.description: HU-016: grounding check of the whole request. `hallucinationRate` is indicator I21.

unitId.title: Unitid
unitId.description: The unit open in the Generation tab.

id.title: Id
id.description: Keep it when editing; omit it for a new outcome.

text.title: Text
examples: Distingue los protocolos TCP y UDP.

outdated.title: Outdated
outdated.description: The teacher edited the script or description after generating.

invalidated.title: Invalidated
invalidated.description: REV-C8: the prompt or script changed, so the generated file is no longer used. Approval is blocked and the resource is left out of new exports until the file is generated again.

MediaResponse.title: MediaResponse
MediaResponse.description:
Image or audio generated for the resource. `fallback`: no file, the review shows the description or uses the
browser's voice.

fallback.title: Fallback
fallback.description: True when the rule-based planner drafted the plan after the AI failed.

fallbackReason.title: Fallbackreason
fallbackReason.description: Generic public reason; null without fallback.

attempts.title: Attempts
attempts.description: AI calls made to draft the plan: 0 without AI, 1, or 2 when the first plan was invalid and was asked again with its problems.

repairs.title: Repairs
repairs.description: Safe fixes applied to the AI plan without another call (T027 b): a concept repeated in a later item removed when that item keeps enough concepts (`CONCEPT_OWNED_TWICE`, `removed`), or a quantity chosen by the AI lowered to its concepts when the teacher left it free (`NOT_ENOUGH_CONCEPTS`, `quantity_lowered`). Empty when nothing was fixed.

covers.title: Covers
covers.description: Concepts this item develops: short noun phrases of 2 to 4 content words from the material, or acronyms (`CONCEPT_NOT_SHORT` otherwise). Split in `quantity` consecutive blocks.

doesNotCover.title: Doesnotcover
doesNotCover.description: Read-only. The `covers` of the other items, in order.

fragmentIds.title: Fragmentids
fragmentIds.description: Ids of `evidence.fragments` that support the item.

message.title: Message
message.description: In Spanish, shown next to the item.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: `overlap`: it develops a concept of another resource of the plan. `missing_concepts`: it develops none of its own. `outcome_misaligned`: a rules-drafted resource whose cited sentences mention no term of the chosen learning outcome or the unit title; delivered anyway.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: In Spanish, shown to the teacher.

developedConcepts.title: Developedconcepts
developedConcepts.description: Concepts of other resources it develops.

missingOwnConcepts.title: Missingownconcepts
missingOwnConcepts.description: Its own concepts, when it develops none.

PlanWarning.title: PlanWarning
PlanWarning.description:
GEN-P2 (specs/006-plan-de-generacion, research R5): aviso de solapamiento con el plan. GEN-C14 (spec 002,
research R14): aviso de un recurso de reglas que no menciona el resultado elegido ni la unidad.

message.title: Message
message.description: In Spanish, shown to the teacher.

fragmentIds.title: Fragmentids
fragmentIds.description: Fragments of the plan evidence that mention the referent.

Referent.title: Referent
Referent.description: Main authors of the topic found in the unit material. Shown in the UI as «referentes».

version.title: Version
version.description: Version of the previous resource when the regeneration was requested.

expectedVersion.title: Expectedversion
expectedVersion.description: Version you read. The previous resource is discarded only if it is still at it.

RegenerationInput.title: RegenerationInput
RegenerationInput.description: REV-C12: regenerar un recurso desde Revisión.

previousDiscarded.title: Previousdiscarded
previousDiscarded.description: True when the previous resource went to discarded with reason `regenerado`; false when it was edited meanwhile and both stay in review.

newResourceIds.title: Newresourceids
newResourceIds.description: Resources created by Generation, waiting for review.

status.title: Status
status.description: `succeeded`, or `running` while Generation works in the background: ask `GET …/regeneration` until it ends.

previousDiscarded.title: Previousdiscarded
previousDiscarded.description: True when the previous resource went to discarded with reason `regenerado`; false when it was edited meanwhile and both stay in review.

newResourceIds.title: Newresourceids
newResourceIds.description: Resources created by Generation, waiting for review.

status.title: Status
status.description: `running` while Generation works; `succeeded` (the previous one is discarded only if unchanged) or `failed`.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why it failed, in Spanish. Only for `failed`.

code.title: Code
code.description: Generation code of the rejection (for example NO_PROCESSED_MATERIAL). Only for `failed`.

RegenerationStatusResponse.title: RegenerationStatusResponse
RegenerationStatusResponse.description: D10: state of the last regeneration request of the resource.

planBlock.title: Planblock
planBlock.description: GEN-P2: the block of concepts of the plan item drafted again. Absent for resources without a plan.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why it was rejected, in Spanish.

support.title: Support
support.description: Share of the claim words found in the cited chunks (0 to 1).

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why it was removed, in Spanish.

support.title: Support
support.description: Share of the paragraph words found in the retrieved chunks (0 to 1).

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why it was removed, in Spanish.

type.title: Type
type.description: Id of an active entry of the configurable catalog. Today, the values of `GET /resource-types`.

quantity.title: Quantity
quantity.description: Optional. `null` lets the planner choose, from 1 to 5, according to the available concepts.

correctedClaims.title: Correctedclaims
correctedClaims.description: Claims that cited the wrong chunk and were moved to the one that supports them.

paragraphThreshold.title: Paragraphthreshold
paragraphThreshold.description: Explanation and glossary only: minimum support of each paragraph (HU-049).

paragraphSources.title: Paragraphsources
paragraphSources.description: For each kept paragraph, in order, the chunks that support it.

removedParagraphs.title: Removedparagraphs
removedParagraphs.description: Paragraphs removed from the content because the material does not support them.

ResourceGrounding.title: ResourceGrounding
ResourceGrounding.description: HU-016: each claim is checked against the retrieved evidence; the unsupported ones are removed.

misconception.title: Misconception
misconception.description: Distractors only: the conceptual error the distractor represents (HU-019).

reliabilityWarning.title: Reliabilitywarning
reliabilityWarning.description: Why the distractor was discarded automatically: the material shows it as correct (HU-019). The teacher can accept it again.

stage.title: Stage
stage.description: 5E stage: engage, explore, explain, elaborate or evaluate.

body.title: Body
body.description: Content. In questions it is the prompt; paragraphs separated by a blank line.

bodyHtml.title: Bodyhtml
bodyHtml.description: Formatted content from the rich text editor (sanitized).

structure.title: Structure
structure.description: Items of visual, audio and interactive resources (nodes, steps, pairs, statements…).

agent.title: Agent
agent.description: Stage agent that drafted the resource in a sequence request (HU-003).

grounding.description: Grounding check of its claims against the retrieved evidence (HU-016).

version.title: Version
version.description: Current version. Send it back as `expectedVersion` when saving.

verification.description: Last check against the stored evidence copy (REV-01). None until it is checked.

regeneratedFrom.description: For a regenerated resource: the resource and version it replaces (REV-C12).

planWarning.description: GEN-P2: an AI resource delivered although it did not fully follow its plan item (it develops another item's concept or none of its own). GEN-C14: a rules resource that mentions neither the chosen learning outcome nor the unit. Shown in Review; it does not block approval.

reviewReset.title: Reviewreset
reviewReset.description: Only in the save response: true when an approved resource changed its content and went back to review.

approvalBlockers.title: Approvalblockers
approvalBlockers.description: Reasons that block approval, computed by the same rule that validates approval.

modalities.title: Modalities
modalities.description: Modalities that include this type (HU-024). Every catalog type belongs to at least one.

relevance.title: Relevance
relevance.description: Relevance reported by Material, from 0 to 1.

RetrievedFragment.title: RetrievedFragment
RetrievedFragment.description: Un fragmento recuperado por el pedido, con su procedencia (TA-010).

expectedVersion.title: Expectedversion
expectedVersion.description: Version the edit starts from (the `version` you read). Required (REV-R12).

bodyHtml.title: Bodyhtml
bodyHtml.description: HTML from the editor; only text formatting and web links are kept. If `body` changes and no new `bodyHtml` is sent (missing or equal to the stored one), the stored HTML is cleared and `body` is used.

structure.title: Structure
structure.description: Edited items of the activity or graphic.

ReviewedResourceInput.title: ReviewedResourceInput
ReviewedResourceInput.description:
The teacher's review. Approval is blocked while distractors are pending (409 APPROVAL_BLOCKED). A save that
starts from an outdated version is rejected (409 VERSION_CONFLICT).

rejected.title: Rejected
rejected.description: Resources rejected for repeating another one, with the reason.

SequenceStep.title: SequenceStep
SequenceStep.description: What one stage agent did in a sequence request.

token.title: Token
token.description: Bearer token. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

expiresIn.title: Expiresin
expiresIn.description: Seconds until the session expires (8 hours).

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: `individual`: exactly one type. `sequence`: one step per type, in 5E order.

unitId.title: Unitid
unitId.description: Unit whose processed material is used.

resourceTypes.title: Resourcetypes
resourceTypes.description: `individual` requires exactly one type. In `sequence`, repeated types are ignored and the steps follow the 5E order.

outcomeId.title: Outcomeid
outcomeId.description: Learning outcome of the unit, optional.

evidenceThreshold.title: Evidencethreshold
evidenceThreshold.description: Minimum share of a claim's words that its cited chunks must contain.

modalities.title: Modalities
modalities.description: Optional. One modality per request (HU-024). When sent, every type in `resourceTypes` must belong to it (422 RESOURCE_TYPE_NOT_IN_MODALITY, nothing is created). When omitted, types are not filtered and the request is saved without a modality. There is no server default.

StartGenerationRequest.title: StartGenerationRequest
StartGenerationRequest.description: Cuerpo de POST /generation-requests. La clave de idempotencia va en la cabecera `Idempotency-Key`.

planId.title: Planid
planId.description: An approved plan of the teacher.

planVersion.title: Planversion
planVersion.description: The plan version the teacher approved; another version answers 409.

StartPlannedGenerationRequest.title: StartPlannedGenerationRequest
StartPlannedGenerationRequest.description: GEN-P2: cuerpo de POST /generation-requests con un plan aprobado (specs/006-plan-de-generacion).

fallback.title: Fallback
fallback.description: True when the rule-based generator drafted after the AI failed.

fallbackReason.title: Fallbackreason
fallbackReason.description: In Spanish: why the AI draft was not used (the same warning as the server log). `null` when `fallback` is false.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: In Spanish, shown to the teacher.

StepPlanWarning.title: StepPlanWarning
StepPlanWarning.description: GEN-P2: un recurso de la IA entregado con aviso de solapamiento con su plan (research R5).

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: In Spanish, shown to the teacher.

verificationStatus.title: Verificationstatus
verificationStatus.description: Current `verification.status` of the resource in Review (REV-01). Generation delivers `current` or `pending`; `insufficient` appears after an edit in Review. `pending` if the resource has no verification.

StepResource.title: StepResource
StepResource.description: Vista corta de un recurso entregado a Revisión.

maxResults.title: Maxresults
maxResults.description: Maximum number of articles to add.

number.title: Number
number.description: Position of the unit in the course, from 1.

items.title: Items
items.description: The new list, in the order the teacher wants inside each stage. An empty list is saved and reported as `PLAN_EMPTY`.

status.title: Status
status.description: Shown as vigente, insuficiente or pendiente. Only `current` with the current fingerprint counts.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why it is not current, in Spanish. Set unless `current`.

verifiedVersion.title: Verifiedversion
verifiedVersion.description: Resource version whose content was verified.

evidenceThreshold.title: Evidencethreshold
evidenceThreshold.description: Threshold of the original request, reused on every check.

retryAvailable.title: Retryavailable
retryAvailable.description: True only for `pending` with a complete evidence copy: «Reintentar comprobación» is offered.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: What was checked, kept or removed.

VerificationResult.title: VerificationResult
VerificationResult.description: REV-01: result of checking the current content against the stored evidence copy (REV-R4, REV-R5).

expectedVersion.title: Expectedversion
expectedVersion.description: Version you read. The retry does not change it.

VerificationRetryInput.title: VerificationRetryInput
VerificationRetryInput.description: «Reintentar comprobación» de un recurso con verificación pendiente (REV-C3).

TeacherSession.description: Get the token with POST /api/v1/sessions (or POST /api/v1/accounts). In Authorize paste only the token.
